strow.stentry: Draft, not reviewed, and unconfirmed: the group did not re-form reliably (stability 0.56). It is named only because a need points at it.
Shropshire (7), North Lincolnshire (6), Lancashire (5), Bristol (4), Dorset (3)

Mixed: the group holds more than one kind of service. It would split into taught courses, workshops and professional training on mental health, and self-help tools such as apps and information on coping.
Did not recur reliably when the data was resampled; it is named only because a need points at it, so treat the name as a proposal and the group as unconfirmed.
